endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: ia_floyd_county_idlewild_canoe_access_anchor_20260918 cedar-river-guide-idlewild-access-coordinate-floyd-county-west-idlewild-canoe-access: The Charles City Chamber of Commerce Cedar River Paddling Trips guide names Idlewild Park Access, gives the West Idlewild address at 1374 Quarry Road, and publishes 43.1633388,-92.7540921, matching the stored point. Floyd County's current West Idlewild Campground record identifies the county facility on the Cedar River and lists canoe access; Floyd County Conservation also describes a Cedar River float taking out at West Idlewild. The matching point identifies the access area, not a surveyed river-entry toe. Imagery shows the park/road approach beside the river under heavy tree cover; retain the point as an access-site anchor and leave the mapped-water offset reviewable.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (ia_floyd_county_idlewild_canoe_access_anchor_20260918 cedar-river-guide-idlewild-access-coordinate-floyd-county-west-idlewild-canoe-access) on Cedar River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.
